title: Sample transcriber's note (rule 13.6.2)

illustrates.quote: Treat the poem as a single level, using 1-3 margins, when the indentions of irregular lines of poetry have no discernible pattern or the poem uses uneven spacing. Some poems may need a transcriber’s note of explanation. Sample: The poem has inconsistent indention patterns, which are not reproduced. or The poem has multiple irregular indentions, which are not reproduced.
